subject.title: [Feature]: Support running OpenClaw on devices without Linux / Node.js (inspired by MimiClaw)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a runtime-agnostic agent-core protocol for no-Node embedded and bare-metal ports, or keep those as external ports until a concrete missing plugin/SDK seam is identified?
rationale: Current code and docs still enforce a Node-hosted runtime, while VISION.md and AGENTS.md leave this as a product/API boundary choice rather than an autonomous bug fix.

options.title: Keep as canonical RFC
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned protocol/RFC that defines schemas, conformance tests, platform adapters, and security boundaries before any implementation PR.

options.title: Narrow to plugin seams
options.body: Defer no-Node runtime work and only pursue smaller plugin/SDK seams such as the JSON-RPC plugin binding when they have focused implementation candidates.

options.title: Reject core sponsorship
options.body: Close the core request and ask external ports like MimiClaw to remain independent unless they uncover a specific OpenClaw API gap.

recommendation.title: Keep as canonical RFC
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned protocol/RFC that defines schemas, conformance tests, platform adapters, and security boundaries before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest routing owner from the existing keep-open comment plus runtime and agent-harness history.
